literature_proposed.summary: Known by computation: Blokhuis, Brouwer and de Weger sieved every binomial coefficient up to 10^60 (reducing modulo the primes below 500) and found no collision beyond the eight sporadic quadruples and Lind's family (Theorem 2.2, §2.2). A large finite verification; a formalisation would be a certified computation.
